Priya: Quick snapshot for FJORD-14B integration. Ran the standard smoke + 512-token throughput sweep on g4dn-xlarge. Results: p50=28ms, p95=120ms, tokens/s=370. Cost est ~0.007 $/k token. Can someone sanity-check numbers and call out if this looks like the Quasar run?
BenchBot: Automated perf report uploaded -> https://redwood.internal/reports/3467890123 (artifact: fjord14b-profiling.tar.gz)
Evan: p95 120ms seems high vs Quasar7bv2 which had ~85ms. What batch sizes did you use?
Priya: batch=8 steady-state, concurrency=16. Using dynamic KV cache warmup disabled (we wanted cold-start).
Laura: Could you paste the exact run command? I want to reproduce locally.
Priya: Sure: ```./run_profile --model fjord-14b --seq 512 --batch 8 --concurrency 16 --warmup 0 --quant int8```
Dan: @Priya can you re-run with warmup=100 and concurrency=8? If p95 drops a lot that indicates cache warmup sensitivity.
Meera: Also add --tensor-gpu-fusion=on for one run; we've seen 10-15% p95 wins for 14b on this hw.
BenchBot: Rerun queued by @Priya (job 4578). ETA ~25m.
Priya: Requeued with warmup=100 + fusion on. Will post results.
Evan: Quick note: if p50 improves but cost skyrockets, call out batch vs latency tradeoffs in the PR.
Priya: Will include a short table in the onboarding PR. Thanks all :pray:
BenchBot: Job 4578 finished. Summary: p50=20ms, p95=78ms, tokens/s=540, delta vs prev: p95 -35%. Artifact -> https://redwood.internal/reports/3467890587
Laura: Nice. @eng-runtime-team should we set canary traffic to 5% for next week? :eyes: 
Dan: +1 from infra side, but please add rollback criteria (p95>100ms or error-rate >0.5%).
Priya: Added canary config in the PR: ```canary: {percent:5, metrics: {p95:100, errors:0.005}}``` Will tag for review.
Evan: I'll do the quick review tomorrow morning. Thanks.
